title: Use Story Studio’s Canvas to map scenes and maintain continuity before…
content:
Use Story Studio’s Canvas to map scenes and maintain continuity before rendering, so your script becomes a coherent sequence instead of unrelated clips  
Follow this workflow: write the script → use Story Studio Canvas to storyboard/map scenes → render each beat with Seedance 2.0 Mini → assemble the finished story
